hero.subtitle: 三十年专注一件事
hero.description: Since 1995, Kingwood has focused on one thing — engineering batteries for the most demanding environments. From military supply to aviation power, we exist for applications that cannot fail.

intro.p1: Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Meizhou, Guangdong, Kingwood is a battery manufacturer with 30 years of expertise, producing the KINGWOOD-branded product line.
intro.p2: The company operates 0.5 GWh of annual capacity across five battery chemistries — lithium titanate (LTO), lithium iron phosphate (LFP), nickel-manganese-cobalt (NMC), lithium manganese oxide (LMO), and sodium-ion — a rare multi-chemistry profile in the Chinese cell industry.
intro.p3: Kingwood serves B2B customers exclusively across six verticals: low-altitude economy, defense & specialty, industrial vehicles, commercial transport, energy storage, and telecom/data. Our customer roster includes leading Chinese eVTOL OEMs, defense research institutes, and industrial equipment manufacturers.

why.p1: Global lithium supply imbalance and price volatility have made sodium — abundant and cost-stable — the inevitable substitute in applications insensitive to energy density: storage, low-speed EVs, and backup power.
why.p2: Kingwood's sodium-ion bet isn't trend-chasing — it's the result of years of materials and process accumulation, combined with deep partnerships across academia, upstream suppliers, and pioneer OEMs.

hero.description: From manned aircraft at thousands of meters, to defense equipment at −40°C, from urban transit to data center backup — Kingwood's portfolio covers six demanding B2B verticals.

lowAltitude.title: Low-Altitude Economy
lowAltitude.lead: Cell supplier to China's trillion-yuan national strategy.
lowAltitude.p1: Manned eVTOLs, industrial UAVs, and aviation backup demand aviation-grade specifications — high energy density, high discharge rate, strict consistency, and safety redundancy.
lowAltitude.p2: KW-eVTOL-01 has shipped over one million units commercially, with established partnerships with leading Chinese eVTOL OEMs.

defense.title: Defense & Specialty
defense.lead: Qualified supplier of specialty defense equipment.
defense.p1: Military and defense applications demand the strictest standards: stable output at extreme temperatures, zero thermal runaway, ultra-long service life.
defense.p2: Kingwood LTO cells operate at −40°C nominally (−68°C at limit), deliver 20,000+ cycles with intrinsic zero lithium plating — the chemistry of choice for cold-region equipment, emergency power, and specialty aerospace.

industrial.title: Industrial Vehicles
industrial.lead: Fast charging and long cycle life — the core of industrial uptime.
industrial.p1: Forklifts, sweepers, and AGVs operate in multi-shift duty cycles. Battery fast-charge capability and cycle life directly determine operational cost.
industrial.p2: KW-LTO-14500's 8C fast charging and 20,000+ cycle life eliminate the wait time, lowering lifetime cost across the fleet.
scenarios: Port and airport ground support equipment

commercial.title: Commercial Transport
commercial.lead: Stable power for low-speed EVs and short-haul commercial vehicles.
commercial.p1: Electric buses, low-speed EVs, and golf carts prioritize low cost, long life, and stable output — not extreme energy density.
commercial.p2: Kingwood's multi-chemistry portfolio enables flexible NMC / LFP / LTO configuration per application, balancing range, cycle life, and cost.

storage.title: Storage & Backup
storage.lead: Full-scenario solutions for C&I storage, outdoor power, and RV.
storage.p1: Storage applications are insensitive to energy density but highly sensitive to cycle life, cost, and safety.
storage.p2: Kingwood sodium-ion delivers generational advantages in cycle life, wide-temperature operation, and cost — the core chemistry for next-generation storage and backup.

telecom.title: Telecom & Data
telecom.lead: Reliable backup for telecom base stations and data centers.
telecom.p1: Telecom base stations and data centers demand exceptional cycle life, temperature tolerance, and long-term reliability from backup systems.
telecom.p2: Kingwood's 1U/3U standard modular backup solutions, combined with LTO and LFP chemistries, cover everything from base stations to large data centers.
